name: Headlines
author: ViberDock
description: The latest headlines of an RSS or Atom feed you choose. The tile shows the newest one (or each in turn); a click opens the list, and a click on a headline opens it in your browser. Enter the feed's address in the settings: ViberDock asks before the widget may connect to that site.

settings.label: Feed address
settings.description: The address of an RSS or Atom feed (https://...). When you enter it, ViberDock asks whether the widget may connect to that site. Plain http only for a device on your local network.

settings.label: Refresh every
settings.description: How often the feed is fetched again. Default: 30 minutes.

settings.label: Headlines in the list
settings.description: How many of the newest headlines the popup lists. Default: 10.

settings.label: Show each headline in turn
settings.description: The tile steps through the newest headlines while the dock is on screen. Off: the newest one only.

settings.label: Each headline for
settings.description: How long the tile shows each headline. Default: 12 seconds.

settings.label: Show the feed's name
settings.description: A small line with the feed's name over the headline.

settings.label: Width on a top or bottom dock
settings.description: How wide the tile is along a horizontal dock. Default: 220.
